snapshot: Current historical dashboard snapshot, not data downloaded contemporaneously in 2022–2025. Historical revisions may exist.
national_count_note: Counts are deduplicated within prescribing practices and then aggregated; national unique-person counts are not guaranteed.
period_note: Only windows entirely contained in January 2022–April 2025 are analysed. Two early endmonth-only study rows extend into 2021 and are retained for provenance only.
lookback_indicators_excluded: VPA4/VPA5 numerical series are omitted. Live chart/card tooltip definitions conflict with the currently linked 2021 specification; this package does not silently repair those definitions. No new-use/resumption effect is computed.
